unit_note: USD millions. Page 25, Table 6 Schedule C, Borrowing from the US Treasury: Commerce, Defense, Education and Energy. All 13 printed lines are kept. Economic Development Administration, listed in September, does not print in October. Only Federal Direct Student Loans and Teach Grant Loans print amounts for This Month, giving 4 roll-forwards (2 exact, 2 within 1; rounding note on p27). Dots and (**) are omitted.
